scope: Validate source-order resolution of proxy ATTRIBUTE_LAYER/ATTRIBUTE_LINETYPE indices and prevent unresolved references from being silently rendered with inherited or BYLAYER properties.

behavior.omittedLookupTable: Keep the parent layer/linetype inherited, as the decoder API contract specifies.
behavior.suppliedLookupTable: Resolve the proxy index against the supplied source-storage-order vector.
behavior.missingOrOutOfRangeEntry: Stop with InvalidResourceReference instead of silently inheriting a layer or rewriting an unresolved linetype as BYLAYER.
behavior.sentinels: Existing BYBLOCK/BYLAYER sentinel decoding is unchanged.

profiles: ATTRIBUTE_LAYER index 1 maps to SOURCE_LAYER_1 even when the parent layer has a different name.
ATTRIBUTE_LINETYPE index 1 maps to SOURCE_LTYPE_1 even when the parent linetype has a different name.
An omitted linetype lookup table leaves the parent linetype inherited.
A supplied linetype vector missing index 1 returns InvalidResourceReference before the following circle is emitted.
A supplied layer vector with an empty entry at index 1 returns InvalidResourceReference before the following circle is emitted.
generatedControl.fixturePolicy: Proxy bytes are generated in memory. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

physicalObservation.result: DWG reading succeeds, but output preflight refuses with typed-proxy-graphics-not-preserved count=36 firstHandle=11344. decodedProxyPrimitives=0 shows the refusal occurs before proxy-cache decoding.
physicalObservation.evidenceCeiling: The physical run confirms whole-cache output remains refused; it does not exercise or qualify the new generated invalid-index behavior, cache replay, or native rendering.

claimBoundary: The change prevents unsupported source resource references from being silently normalized in decoded proxy geometry.
It does not remap embedded raw proxy-cache indices for a destination DXF resource order.
It does not qualify whole-cache output, the AC1021 sample, or native rendering semantics.
